title: [ Craftable Wheat Seeds 1.3.1] Craft The_Uncraftable
description: This Minecraft Java Edition Data Pack adds recipes to uncraftable items.
body: This is Craft The Uncraftable Minecraft Java Edition Data Pack in which you can craft Uncraftable Items. It includes recipes for End Portal Frames, Name Tages, Totem of Undying, Triedent and Enchanted Golden Apples!
